findings.problem: Native multi-selection and F2 are issued while the local match is paused.
findings.trigger: load() pauses; formation line42 selectsMany before resume; hold line36 pauses then selectsMany; morale line97 ground click and F2 precede resume.
findings.sourceProof: native-context.mjs:74-78 selects first unit through WorldTools, then remaining units using Shift entityClick. GameScene.ts:136 sets playable false for paused local play; pointerdown/up at169/182 ignore input. Controls.ts:12 and73 bind F2 to playable context.
findings.effect: First formation cannot finish its six-unit selection; later morale army selection/hold can fail as well. Single-unit selectMany is unaffected because WorldTools does that first selection.
findings.repair: Resume before actual battlefield multi-selection/F2 and account for native auto-fire windows using disclosed starting cooldowns or an existing supported native selector. Do not write selection/state directly.

findings.problem: Hold does not prevent firing at in-range hostiles.
findings.sourceProof: simulation.ts:563 acquires and fights enemies under hold order.
findings.effect: The rider can hit again after its1.3-second cooldown, and held engines may launch again if ready before targets withdraw. Pausing and endpoint HP assertions detect some drift; Hold alone does not establish first-hit isolation.
findings.repair: Preserve the paused first-hit endpoint directly; if a later native command is needed, describe Hold accurately and verify timing/extra hits from retained replay. An actual native withdrawal can suppress combat if needed.
